verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents AI-driven browser agents that start with a single API call and run in managed cloud sessions, with built-in Claude, OpenAI, Gemini and BrowserUse agents. HyperAgent's page.ai() takes natural-language multi-step goals, for example searching flights and then selecting the cheapest option. The evidence is vendor-only, though, and form filling and end-to-end flow completion are implied rather than explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of form filling and click-through flows, independent or hands-on corroboration that agents finish multi-step tasks end to end, and details on agent reliability or failure handling.

support.subject: As a developer, I can hand the product a natural-language goal and it completes a multi-step web task end to end — navigating, filling forms, and clicking through flows

citations.quote: Hyperbrowser lets you run powerful, AI-driven browser agents in managed cloud sessions. Whether you prefer open-source frameworks or cutting‑edge model-native agents, you can start tasks with a single API call and watch them execute live.
await page.ai("search for flights from Miami to LAX, select the cheapest option");
Built in support for Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, and BrowserUse agents.
Write natural language commands instead of complex selectors
